functions.title: GOVERN
functions.text: A culture of risk management is cultivated and present. GOVERN is a cross-cutting function that is infused throughout AI risk management and enables the other functions of the process.

categories.title: Policies, processes, procedures, and practices across the organization related to the mapping, measuring, and managing of AI risks are in place, transparent, and implemented effectively.
Accountability structures are in place so that the appropriate teams and individuals are empowered, responsible, and trained for mapping, measuring, and managing AI risks.
Workforce diversity, equity, inclusion, and accessibility processes are prioritized in the mapping, measuring, and managing of AI risks throughout the lifecycle.
Organizational teams are committed to a culture that considers and communicates AI risk.
Processes are in place for robust engagement with relevant AI actors.
Policies and procedures are in place to address AI risks and benefits arising from third-party software and data and other supply chain issues.

functions.title: MAP
functions.text: Context is recognized and risks related to context are identified. The MAP function establishes the context to frame risks related to an AI system.

categories.title: Categorization of the AI system is performed.
AI capabilities, targeted usage, goals, and expected benefits and costs compared with appropriate benchmarks are understood.
Risks and benefits are mapped for all components of the AI system including third-party software and data.
Impacts to individuals, groups, communities, organizations, and society are characterized.

functions.title: MEASURE
functions.text: Identified risks are assessed, analyzed, or tracked. The MEASURE function employs quantitative, qualitative, or mixed-method tools, techniques, and methodologies to analyze, assess, benchmark, and monitor AI risk and related impacts.

categories.title: Appropriate methods and metrics are identified and applied.
AI systems are evaluated for trustworthy characteristics.
Mechanisms for tracking identified AI risks over time are in place.
Feedback about efficacy of measurement is gathered and assessed.

functions.title: MANAGE
functions.text: Risks are prioritized and acted upon based on a projected impact. The MANAGE function entails allocating risk resources to mapped and measured risks on a regular basis and as defined by the GOVERN function.

categories.title: AI risks based on assessments and other analytical output from the MAP and MEASURE functions are prioritized, responded to, and managed.
Strategies to maximize AI benefits and minimize negative impacts are planned, prepared, implemented, documented, and informed by input from relevant AI actors.
AI risks and benefits from third-party entities are managed.
Risk treatments, including response and recovery, and communication plans for the identified and measured AI risks are documented and monitored.
